panels.label: 03 — Private Equity
panels.heading: Partnership that creates value.
panels.lead: Investment in businesses, active collaboration with management and strategic value creation.

panels.imageAlt: A person in a camel jacket working at a laptop beside a cup of coffee
panels.label: Investing in businesses
panels.heading: Alongside management, not above it.
panels.text: We invest in businesses and work actively with the people who run them. Management teams keep the knowledge of their markets; we contribute capital, structure and an outside perspective, and we stay involved.

items.title: Strategic direction
items.text: Working with management to sharpen priorities and the plan for reaching them.

items.title: Operational collaboration
items.text: Practical involvement where it helps, from planning to execution.

items.title: Disciplined decisions
items.text: Investments and follow-on decisions are made against clear criteria.

items.title: A long-term perspective
items.text: Value is built over the life of a partnership, not extracted at the first opportunity.

panels.label: Next steps
panels.heading: Exploring a partner for your business?
panels.text: Tell us about the company, its management and what a partnership would need to achieve. We will respond to arrange a conversation.
